title: Juicy Savory Peruvian Sirloin Steak Tips Lomo Saltado
description: A paleo-friendly Peruvian dish featuring sirloin steak tips, inspired by traditional lomo saltado, with umami flavors and a light nostalgic touch
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
Add the sirloin steak tips and cook until browned, about 3 minutes
Remove the steak tips from the skillet and set aside
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3 minutes
Add the diced tomato and minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and vinegar
Pour the soy sauce mixture over the onion and tomato mixture in the skillet
Return the steak tips to the skillet and stir to combine with the sauce
Season with salt and black pepper to taste
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately
